purpose: Phase 2 target: real stateful Foundry invariant tests with setUp() and handler-driven sequences.
why_not_vendored: Third-party contest code is not copied into this repository. Reproducibility comes from URL + commit in this manifest.

verification.solc: as resolved by foundry.toml (src=src, libs=[lib, node_modules])

storage_layout_finding.packing: two uint128 reserves packed in one slot: reserve0 = shr(128, shl(128, sload(slot))) i.e. bits 0..128, reserve1 = shr(128, sload(slot)) i.e. bits 128..256
storage_layout_finding.significance: a real packed-slot case in production code. Reading the whole slot for either reserve returns both, which is exactly the bug the mandatory bit-range rule prevents.

declared_limitation: Every invariant here depends on function calls that return values (getReserves, totalSupply, balanceOf, calcLpTokenSupply) rather than on raw storage words alone. The predicate IR supports a single scalar return word per symbol; it cannot yet express multi-return calls (uint256[] reserves), calls on other contracts (balanceOf of a token), or approximate comparison with a relative tolerance. Phase 2.1 therefore requires extending the IR, not merely wiring it.
